definitions.explanation: The involuntary opening of the mouth wide with a deep breath, typically when tired or bored.

examples.japanese: ⟦{眠|ねむ}くて→眠い：00872_nemui⟧{欠伸|あくび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I'm sleepy and can't stop yawning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{欠伸|あくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's rude to yawn during a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{欠伸|あくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I let out a big yawn.

examples.japanese: {欠伸|あくび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伝染|でんせん}→伝染：04549_densen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Yawns are said to be contagious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}→授業中：20544_jugyouchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{欠伸|あくび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦しまい→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}された→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
examples.english: I kept yawning during class and the teacher warned me.

notes:
KANJI: normally written in hiragana as あくび. The kanji spelling {欠伸|あくび} is a whole-word reading — neither character supplies あ, く, or び on its own — and is rare outside dictionaries and literary writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {欠伸|あくび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: yawn (literally "a yawn comes out"). This is the everyday phrasing, because yawning is involuntary — you report it happening to you rather than doing it.
- {欠伸|あくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: yawn, treated as something you do. Used when the yawn is deliberate or when it matters that you were the one who did it, as in an apology or a scolding.
- {欠伸|あくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: hold a yawn back
- {欠伸|あくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す→噛み殺す：29106_kamikorosu⟧: stifle a yawn (fixed expression, literally "bite it to death")

COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{欠伸|あくび}: a big yawn
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧{欠伸|あくび}: a half-yawn that never quite comes out. Often mentioned as a sign of ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧ or of coming down with something, not just of ⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧.
- {欠伸|あくび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧: boring enough to make you yawn

RELATED INVOLUNTARY BODY ACTIONS: ⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧ (sneeze), ⟦しゃっくり→しゃっくり：05129_shakkuri⟧ (hiccup), ⟦げっぷ→げっぷ：06511_geppu⟧ (burp). All of these take ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ the same way.

REGISTER: yawning in front of others is read as rudeness or boredom in Japan much as elsewhere, so the word turns up often in apologies and in warnings about meetings and classes.
